entry.title: World Sea Turtle Day
entry.summary:
This is a submission for Frontend Challenge - June Celebrations, CSS Art: June Celebrations. World Sea Turtle Day (June 16) celebrates these ancient mariners who have navigated Earth's oceans for over 100 million years. Sea turtles are incredible creatures that face numerous threats, from plastic pollution to climate change. This CSS art honors their graceful swimming patterns and the underwater world they call home.
Journey
This piece challenged me to recreate the elegant motion of sea turtles gliding through water. I used CSS animations to simulate their distinctive swimming pattern - the way they gracefully move their flippers in a synchronized rhythm. The turtle shapes are created entirely with CSS, using clever combinations of border-radius, transforms, and pseudo-elements. The underwater environment features floating seaweed created with CSS animations and a gradient background that mimics the way sunlight filters through ocean water. I experimented with different animation delays to make each turtle move independently, creating a more natural scene. What I'm most proud of is the organic feel of the animations - they don't feel robotic or mechanical. The turtles seem to truly "swim" through their digital ocean. In future iterations, I'd love to add bubbles, more diverse marine life, and perhaps simulate the turtle's journey from nest to ocean.

Um ambiente local completo para rodar LLMs como deepseek-coder e mistral com Docker, Open-WebUI, benchmarks automáticos, fallback inteligente e uma DX otimizada via Makefile ou script Bash — tudo open source, tudo fácil de estender!
🧠 Por que criei isso?
Eu queria um ambiente de IA local que fosse: 💡 Simples de iniciar (make dev ou setup-dev.sh) 🔁 Resiliente (reinicia containers com falha automaticamente) 🧪 Benchmarkado (testa o tempo de resposta logo após subir) 🐳 Totalmente Dockerizado 🤖 Rodando modelos como DeepSeek Coder e Mistral direto no meu PC 🧰 Personalizável para qualquer outro uso com LLMs offline Então eu criei o mori-ollama-srv. ✅ Ollama com suporte a modelos como deepseek-coder:6.7b, mistral, llama
✅ Open-WebUI (interface para chats) ✅ Benchmarks automáticos via script ✅ Docker Compose + Makefile para facilitar tudo ✅ Ativação de modo “performance” na CPU (Linux) ✅ Execução local ou remota via SSH # Rodar com modelo padrão (deepseek) make dev
# Rodar com modelo leve (mistral) make install ARGS="--light"
# Pular benchmark make install ARGS="--no-benchmark"
# Rodar tudo remotamente make install ARGS="--remote=me@192.168.100.10"
